paragraphs: He spoke in Rav Sheshet’s name. See [Bava Metzia 30a](https://www.sefaria.org/Bava_Metzia.30a.13).[^1]

notes.text: The linked Bava Metzia has Rav Ada bar Chama report Rav Sheshet’s explanation concerning a deposit. [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=238&lang=en) gives the same transmission and tentatively compares two other names.
